verdict.rationale: mParticle's homepage says users can describe an audience while the product understands the underlying customer data, suggests segment logic, and exposes reasoning that can be inspected and refined. That maps onto natural-language audience building grounded in data, with review. However, the support is only short marketing taglines, with no product documentation on how the generated segment definition is produced, reviewed, or tied to the user's schema. missing for 10: in-depth docs on the natural-language-to-audience-definition workflow, explicit evidence that generation is grounded in the user's actual schema/attributes, documentation of the review/approval step for generated segments, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can describe an audience in natural language and AI builds the segment definition for review, grounded in my actual schema

citations.quote: Describe the audience, journey, or growth goal. mParticle understands the customer data behind it, suggests the logic to use
Reasoning you can inspect and refine
